# ASSET PROPERTIES — Complete Knowledge & Underwriting Repository
URL: https://properties.assetmagnets.com
Operating Handle: @asset_properties17
Headquarters: Bhubaneswar, Odisha, India
Core Markets: Patia, Infocity, Pahala, Hanspal, Trisulia, Saheed Nagar, Kalinga Nagar, Jayadev Vihar, Nayapalli

## 1. Executive Summary & Philosophy of Refusal
Asset Properties is an institutional-grade digital private wealth sanctuary and real estate advisory firm based in Bhubaneswar, Odisha. Unlike mass aggregation portals that list unverified developer inventory for commissions, Asset Properties operates on a strict "Philosophy of Refusal":
- Out of 142 projects audited across Bhubaneswar, 114 have been disqualified (an 80% rejection rate).
- Only 28 vetted mandates are approved for client acquisition.
- Common reasons for rejection include unverified agricultural land titles (Kissam defects on Bhulekh), non-ORERA marketing with pre-launch collection without escrow, inflated super built-up loading (exceeding 30-40%), flood-basin depression risks along unmapped Gangua or canal paths, and BDA fire-setback encroachments.

## 2. The 100-Point Asset Score™ Underwriting Matrix
Every project undergoes an objective 100-Point audit evaluated across 5 core forensic pillars:
1. Legal Purity & Statutory Approvals (25 Points): ORERA registration, BDA/CDA sanction order, 30-to-40-year Encumbrance Certificate (EC), Bhulekh Gharabari mutation verification.
2. Structural Integrity & Material Grade (20 Points): Mivan aluminum formwork, seismic zone engineering, acoustic decibel insulation, and double-glazed low-E fenestration.
3. True Carpet Area Efficiency (20 Points): Physical Leica laser distometer audits. Eliminates ghost loading; benchmarked at 16% to 22% true loading versus market averages of 33%+.
4. Corridor Capital Growth & Infrastructure Catalysts (20 Points): Proximity to Bhubaneswar-Cuttack Metro Phase-1, IT SEZ expansions, and 200ft CDP master plan arterial rings.
5. Micro-Climate, Light & Vastu Harmony (15 Points): Heliodon sun-path simulations for morning East daylight and unobstructed cross-ventilation.

## 3. Micro-Market Analysis & High-Growth Corridors in Bhubaneswar
- Patia & Infocity IT Corridor: High-density tech executive and medical consultant demand. 12.8% projected annual appreciation, 4.3% residential rental yield, 8.6% commercial office yield.
- Pahala & Hanspal Luxury Villa Belt: Gated landed duplex estates along the 6-lane NH-16 corridor between Bhubaneswar and Cuttack. 13.4% annual appreciation.
- Trisulia Twin-City Metro Belt: High-appreciation capital compounding corridor (15.2% projected CAGR) driven by the proposed Metro terminal and Judicial Academy.
- Saheed Nagar & Jayadev Vihar Institutional Core: Irreplaceable central land parcels with high Undivided Land Share (UDS) and scarcity of new supply.
- Kalinga Nagar & AIIMS Belt: Proximity to healthcare institutions and direct CDP connectivity. 13.9% annual appreciation.

## 4. Odisha Financial & Regulatory Calculus
- Stamp Duty Rates in Odisha: 7% for male buyers, 6% for female buyers (1% concession for female ownership), plus 2% IGR Odisha registration fee.
- GST on Real Estate: 5% on under-construction residential properties (without ITC); 0% GST on completed properties with Occupancy Certificate (OC) issued.
- True Carpet Price Formula: Effective Price per Sq.Ft. = Total Outlay ÷ Laser-Audited RERA Usable Carpet Area.
